import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape;seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool);out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i,j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                stack=[(i,j)];cells=[];seen[i,j]=True
                while stack:
                    r,q=stack.pop();cells.append((r,q))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        rr,cc=r+dr,q+dc
                        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr,cc]!=bg and not seen[rr,cc]: seen[rr,cc]=True;stack.append((rr,cc))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def norm(cells):
    r0=min(p[0] for p in cells); c0=min(p[1] for p in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells))
pairs=[('Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 1 output'),('Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 2 output')]
for n,(k,out_k) in enumerate(pairs,1):
    a=np.array(G[k]); b=np.array(G[out_k])
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for v in a.flatten(): cnt[v]+=1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    ca=comps(a,bg)
    chset=set(zip(*np.where(a!=b)))
    print('pair',n,'bg',bg,'changed cells',sorted(chset))
    compmap={}
    for ci,x in enumerate(ca): compmap[frozenset(x)]=ci
    # group changed cells into contiguous same-color groups? they might be one comp. Check if changed cells form a connected comp of original color
    rs=[r for r,c in chset]; cs_=[c for r,c in chset]
    H,W=a.shape
    R0=min(rs)-1;R1=max(rs)+1;C0=min(cs_)-1;C1=max(cs_)+1
    R0=max(0,R0);R1=min(H-1,R1);C0=max(0,C0);C1=min(W-1,C1)
    block=[a[r,c] for r in range(R0,R1+1) for c in range(C0,C1+1)]
    vals=sorted(set(block))
    print('  block colors:',vals)
    origcol=a[chset[0][0],chset[0][1]]
    newcol=b[chset[0][0],chset[0][1]]
    shapekey=norm([(r-min(rs),c-min(cs_)) for r,c in chset])
    dup=[(tuple(y),a[y[0]],y[1]) for y in ca if frozenset(y)!=frozenset(set(chset)) and len(y)==len(chset) and norm(y)==shapekey][:6]
    print('  ->',newcol,'dup comps:',dup)

from collections import Counter
for n in (1,2,3):
    a=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%n]); b=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%n])
    bg=max(range(10),key=lambda k:Counter(a.flatten())[k])
    ca=getca(a,bg)
    ggd=defaultdict(list)
    for x in ca: ggd[norm(x)].append(x)
    diffs=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(a!=b)))
    print('=== pair',n,'bg',bg)
    for sh,cs_ in sorted(ggd.items(),key=lambda t:-len(t[0])):
        colors=[int(a[p[0][0],p[0][1]]) for c_ in cs_ for p in c_]
        pos=[(min(p[0] for p in c_),min(p[1] for p in c_)) for c_ in cs_]
        mark='*CHANGED' if any(tuple(p) in diffs for c_ in cs_ for p in c_) else ''
        print(sh,len(cs_),'colors',sorted(set(colors)),'positions',pos,mark)

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
for n in (1,2,3):
    a=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); b=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=a.shape; bg=max(Counter(a.flatten()),key=lambda k:(a==k).sum())
    ca=getca(a,bg)
    ggd=defaultdict(list)
    for x in ca: ggd[norm(x)].append(x)
    diff=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(a!=b)))
    print('=== demo',n,'grid',H,W)
    for sh,cs_ in sorted(ggd.items()):
        if len(cs_)!=2: continue
        c0,c1=cs_[0],cs_[1]
        pos0=(min(p[0] for p in c0),min(p[1] for p in c0)); pos1=(min(p[0] for p in c1),min(p[1] for p in c1))
        col0=int(a[c0[0][0],c0[0][1]]); col1=int(a[c1[0][0],c1[0][1]])
        ch0=bool(set(c0)&diff); ch1=bool(set(c1)&diff)
        tgt = int(b[next(iter((set(c0)&diff)|set(c1)&diff)))]) if ((set(c0)&diff)|set(c1)&diff) else None
        print(f'  pos0={pos0} col={col0} sz={len(c0)} touched={ch0} | pos1={pos1} col={col1} sz={len(c1)} touched={ch1} TARGET={tgt}')

steps.input:
def solve(g):
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape
    bg=max(Counter(a.flatten()),key=lambda k:(a==k).sum())
    ca=compinfo(a,bg)
    ggd=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in ca: ggd[normP(cells)].append((c,cells))
    pair=None
    for sh,v in list(ggd.items()):
        if len(v)==2 and pair is None: pair=v; break
    (c0,cel0),(c1,cel1)=pair
    colcnt=Counter()
    for comp,xs_ in ca: colcnt[xs_[0]]=colcnt.get(xs_[0],0)+len(xs_)
    dupcols=[col for col in colcnt if colcnt[col]>1]
    tot=Counter()
    for c,x in ca: tot[c]+=x[1]
    if len(dupcols)==1: tgt=dupcols[0]
    else: tgt=max(tot,key=tot.get)
    recolor = cel0 if c0==tgt else cel1
    out=a.copy()
    for r,c in recolor: out[r,c]=tgt
    return out.tolist()

for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    ok = np.array_equal(np.array(solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])), np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output']))
    print(n, ok)
